learning.help.title: Learning
learning.help.intro: Learning is your personal whiteboard for organizing topics you want to understand and reinforce. Topics and paths live in Pad LOCAL (temas-de-aprendizaje and rutas-de-aprendizaje), and guides read real code in read-only mode.
learning.help.first.title: First steps
learning.help.first.step1: Open the Knowledge base and go to the “🎓 Learning” tab.
learning.help.first.step2: Tap “New topic” and enter what you want to understand, the scope and a specific question if you have one.
learning.help.first.step3: Choose the status and, if several topics form a journey, assign them to a path.
learning.help.first.step4: Open the topic card and add notes or context before generating the guide.
learning.help.first.step5: Tap “🎓 Generate full guide”—the “Explain this” action—or “Regenerate” so the AI navigates code in read-only mode and saves a guided explanation.

learning.help.buttons.title: Buttons and actions
learning.help.buttons.filters.v: Filters the cards without changing topic statuses.
learning.help.buttons.newTopic.v: Creates a topic with scope, status, priority, path, question and notes.
learning.help.buttons.analyze.v: Available to administrators: organizes all learning with AI and proposes duplicates, paths and next topics. It uses tokens; nothing is applied without your approval.
learning.help.buttons.routes.v: Expands the journeys and their progress calculated from mastered topics.
learning.help.buttons.newRoute.v: Creates a journey for grouping related topics.
learning.help.buttons.routeTitle.v: Filters the grid to show only its topics.
learning.help.buttons.routeEdit.v: Changes the journey's title, status and description.
learning.help.buttons.routeDelete.v: Deletes the path but leaves its topics without a path.
learning.help.buttons.card.v: Opens notes, additional context, guide, sections and topic actions.
learning.help.buttons.notes.v: Saves your own Markdown context; it doesn't use tokens.
learning.help.buttons.addNote.v: Adds a manual entry to the additional context.
learning.help.buttons.interpret.v: Turns a pasted talk into a context entry. It uses tokens.
learning.help.buttons.explain.v: Available to administrators: navigates real code with read-only tools and saves the explanation. It uses tokens only when the guide needs to be generated or adapted.
learning.help.buttons.force.v: Ignores the previous guide and generates it from scratch. It uses tokens.
learning.help.buttons.chat.v: Opens a separate work session with all topic context; the session uses tokens while you work and, when it closes, its summary returns to the whiteboard.
learning.help.buttons.delete.v: Deletes the topic and its guided explanation after asking for confirmation.
learning.help.warning.title: Watch out
learning.help.warning.text: This is a whiteboard, not a workshop: code in the guide is demonstrative; it doesn't run or persist changes to files. Generating or adapting a guide uses tokens and navigates the repository in read-only mode. To run or change code for real, open “Deep-dive in chat” or a separate work session. Deleting a topic also deletes its guide and can't be undone.
